_about: Public-domain Wilbur Fisk (1792-1839), Methodist Episcopal minister and first President of Wesleyan University, for the Word Hoard: A Discussion on Universal Salvation (1832), the Calvinistic Controversy (1835) and Travels on the Continent of Europe (1838). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 73 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

fisk-universal-salvation: A Discussion on Universal Salvation: In Three Lectures and Five Answers Against that Doctrine (B. Waugh and T. Mason, 1832)
fisk-calvinistic-controversy: Calvinistic controversy : embracing a sermon on predestination and election, and several numbers formerly published in the Christian Advocate and Journal (New York : Waugh and Mason for the Methodist Episcopal Church, 1835)
fisk-travels-europe: Travels on the continent of Europe; viz., in England, Ireland, Scotland, France, Italy, Switzerland, Germany, and the Netherlands (New-York, Harper and brothers, 1838)

_excluded.fisk-other: single printed sermons and addresses (1826-1835); The Methodist Preacher (1859, sermons by several hands)

fisk-travels-europe.ia_possible_copyright_status: The Library of Congress is unaware of any copyright restrictions for this item.
